in_sanskrit.name: Iāryiś
in_sanskrit.meaning: The one who is noble and virtuous
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: आर्यः (āryaḥ) - noble, virtuous; इश् (iś) - lord, master. The one who is the noble and virtuous master.

in_hindi.name: Iāryiś
in_hindi.meaning: The one who is noble and virtuous
in_hindi.long_meaning: आर्यः (āryaḥ) - noble, virtuous; इश् (iś) - lord, master. The one who is the noble and virtuous master.

in_tamil.name: Aṟiyiṣ
in_tamil.meaning: The one who is noble and virtuous
in_tamil.long_meaning: அறிய் (aṟiy) - to know, to understand; இஷ் (iṣ) - lord, master. The one who is the knower and master.

in_telugu.name: Aṟyiś
in_telugu.meaning: The one who is noble and virtuous
in_telugu.long_meaning: అర్యః (aryaḥ) - noble, virtuous; శ్ (ś) - lord, master. The one who is the noble and virtuous master.

in_marathi.name: Aryish
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Noble, Honorable, Valiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aryish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'arya' meaning noble, honorable, and valiant. This name is associated with the ancient Aryan civilization, known for their wisdom, courage, and cultural achievements.
